Name: Total seasonal precipitation
Definition / Calculation Logic: Sum of daily rainfall on wet days (P ≥ 1.0 mm)

Name: Wet-day frequency
Definition / Calculation Logic: Percentage of days with P ≥ 1.0 mm in season

Name: Maximum 1-day precipitation
Definition / Calculation Logic: Highest single-day precipitation amount in season

Name: Maximum 5-day consecutive precipitation
Definition / Calculation Logic: Highest 5-day consecutive precipitation sum in season

Name: Consecutive dry days
Definition / Calculation Logic: Maximum number of consecutive dry days (P < 1.0 mm)

Name: Consecutive wet days
Definition / Calculation Logic: Maximum number of consecutive wet days (P ≥ 1.0 mm)

Name: Heavy precipitation days
Definition / Calculation Logic: Count of days with daily precipitation P ≥ 10.0 mm

Name: Very heavy precipitation days
Definition / Calculation Logic: Count of days with daily precipitation P ≥ 20.0 mm
